name: btw-selection-quote
title: Fix BTW side-question quote capture
description: Fix right-click selection capture so selected Pi terminal text is passed as the quote into the BTW side-question panel. Preserve the manual question flow: do not auto-submit; the user enters a question and explicitly clicks Ask.
creator: Pi
notes: Root-cause statement: Pi TUI enables terminal mouse reporting, so ordinary drag events are consumed by Pi and its visible highlight is application-rendered rather than an xterm/DOM selection; runtime length-only diagnostics confirmed terminal.getSelection(), the menu snapshot, and caches all remained zero. Fix lands at the terminal mouse boundary: for Pi sessions, mirror drag start/end cells without blocking Pi, clear the previous mirrored selection and caches at each new drag, and always replace the host xterm selection with the latest non-empty drag range on mouseup. The existing right-click handoff and manual question submission remain unchanged. Temporary diagnostics were removed. Tests: node --test scripts/terminalTabRow.test.mjs scripts/terminalBtwPanel.test.mjs scripts/terminalBtwCommand.test.mjs (15 passed); npx tsc --noEmit passed; git diff --check passed. GitNexus CLI unavailable; targeted symbol search confirmed the context-menu to panel handoff.
